def WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation : {m : ℕ} → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ → Prop :=
fun {m} R => R.PosSemidef ∧ ∀ (i : Fin m), R i i = 1

def FSC.Peano2.{u_1} : {V : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] → [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ V] → (V → ℝ) → V → (V →L[ℝ] ℝ) → (V →L[ℝ] V →L[ℝ] ℝ) → Prop :=
fun {V} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] f x l B =>
  (fun h => f (x + h) - f x - l h - 1 / 2 * (B h) h) =o[nhds 0] fun h => ‖h‖ ^ 2

def FSC.pairCov : {n : ℕ} → FSC.Mat n → Fin n → Fin n → FSC.Mat n :=
fun {n} G i j => FSC.pairResidual G i j * G * Matrix.transpose (FSC.pairResidual G i j)

def FSC.pairEvent : {n : ℕ} → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ → Set (FSC.Coord n) :=
fun {n} i j t => {x | ∀ (k : Fin n), k ≠ i → k ≠ j → x.ofLp k ≤ t}

def FSC.q : {n : ℕ} → FSC.Mat n → ℝ → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ :=
fun {n} G t i j =>
  if i ≠ j ∧ -1 < G i j ∧ G i j < 1 then
    WeakSimplex.normalPDF t * WeakSimplex.normalPDF (FSC.pairSupport G t i j) / FSC.pairSigma G i j *
      FSC.pairSuccess G i j t
  else 0

def FSC.NoCoincident.{u_1} : {d : ℕ} → {ι : Type u_1} → (ι → FSC.Coord d) → (ι → ℝ) → Prop :=
fun {d} {ι} w b => ∀ (j k : ι), j ≠ k → (w j = w k → b j ≠ b k) ∧ (w j = -w k → b j ≠ -b k)

def FSC.supportGradient.{u_1} : {d : ℕ} →
  {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → (ι → FSC.Coord d) → (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
fun {d} {ι} [Fintype ι] w b =>
  ∑ j, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j).smulRight (WeakSimplex.normalPDF (b j) * FSC.sliceMass w b j)
